Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops

Record Class JobsRest.Restock

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.ops.JobsRest.Restock
Record Components:
perSpecies - How many pets of each species to add (1-50 each).
idempotencyKey - The client-minted key; resubmits with the same key return the same job.
slowMs - How long to wait before restocking, in whole milliseconds (0-10000), so a demo can cancel before the effect.
holdMs - How long to hold after restocking, in whole milliseconds (0-10000, default 1000), so a demo can cancel after the effect.
Enclosing class:
JobsRest
public static record JobsRest.Restock(Map<Species,Integer> perSpecies, String idempotencyKey, int slowMs, int holdMs) extends Record
The restock request.
Example:

// Wire form: {perSpecies:{DOG:2, CAT:1}, idempotencyKey:'7f3c...'} var r = new Restock(Map.of(Species.DOG, 2), "7f3c", 0, 1000);

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static JobsRest.Restock of(JsonMap body)
      Reads a restock from any of its wire shapes: the API form {perSpecies:{DOG:2}, idempotencyKey}, the dialog form the views runtime posts, {action, targetId, idempotencyKey, fields:{DOG:"2"}}, or the job-log card's flat form {DOG:2, slowMs:0, idempotencyKey}. In the dialog and flat forms a blank, null or 0 count means "none of that species". Any form may carry slowMs and holdMs; each must be a whole number of milliseconds, so a decimal such as 1.5 is rejected rather than truncated.
      Parameters:
      body - The request body.
      Returns:
      The restock.
      Throws:
      BadRequest - If a species is unknown, a count is not a whole number, slowMs is not a whole number 0-10000, or holdMs is not a whole number 0-10000.
